patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Makes the bundled Google LVL policy always report the app as licensed, and bypasses the native engine: it drops the System.loadLibrary("d") call whose library aborts the process on a re-signed APK, and stubs the methods that library provided so the app cannot die with UnsatisfiedLinkError. Features that need the engine stay unavailable.
